entries.desc: ChecklistStatus accepts withdrawn and a withdrawn item with decisionRef round-trips through readChecklist/writeChecklist unchanged

evidence.note: Positive path sets item.status=withdrawn with decisionRef and reads it back through checklist_get; round-trips through store read/write.

entries.desc: A legacy checklist item (no status=withdrawn, no decisionRef) still loads and reads exactly as before

evidence.note: Checklist items seeded without status=withdrawn/decisionRef load and render exactly as before (all fixture items lack decisionRef).

entries.desc: checklist_update refuses a direct status=withdrawn write and its error points to scope_shrinkage_decision_set as the sole authorized applier

evidence.note: Direct checklist_update status=withdrawn throws matching /scope_shrinkage_decision_set/ and the item stays done (no write).

entries.desc: checklistAllDoneGuard treats withdrawn as terminal so DEV->REVIEW advances when every item is done-or-withdrawn

evidence.note: checklistAllDoneGuard returns true for a done+withdrawn checklist, so DEV->REVIEW advances treating withdrawn as terminal.

entries.desc: delivered/completed counts (checklist.ts:82, story-query:568, hints:70, session:435, milestone-status) exclude withdrawn from delivered totals

evidence.note: slim counts and summarizeChecklist report done=1 (delivered-only) and withdrawn=1 separately; withdrawn never increments the delivered/done tally.

entries.desc: No renderer (checklist_get, story_get, session_brief, exports) ever prints a withdrawn item as DONE

evidence.note: checklist_get renders the withdrawn item with status 'withdrawn' and asserts notEqual 'done' — no renderer shows it as DONE.

entries.desc: buildScopeShrinkageDecision persists decisionId, withdrawnChecklistItemRefs, withdrawnAcceptanceBindingRefs and evidenceRefs and scope_shrinkage_decision_get returns them

evidence.note: buildScopeShrinkageDecision generates an SD- decisionId, persists withdrawnChecklistItemRefs, and preserves createdAt/decisionId across updates.

entries.desc: A legacy decision.json without the new fields (B-bf52 fixture) loads with safe empty defaults and does not throw

evidence.note: A legacy decision object with no new fields loads; withdrawnChecklistItemIdsFrom/withdrawnBindingIdsFrom return empty sets and effectiveAcceptanceBindings keeps all bindings.

entries.desc: A confirmed decision that names no withdrawnChecklistItemRefs, no withdrawnAcceptanceBindingRefs and no removedMilestoneIds is rejected (nothing to withdraw)

evidence.note: A confirmed decision naming no withdrawnChecklistItemRefs/withdrawnAcceptanceBindingRefs/removedMilestoneIds is rejected (nothing to withdraw).

entries.desc: The decision writer appends {bindingId,disposition:withdrawn,decisionRef} to proofstory.json and proofstory_contract_get shows the disposition, invoked from DEV and from REVIEW with no PLAN return

evidence.note: scope_shrinkage_decision_set appends {bindingId,disposition:withdrawn,decisionRef} and proofstory_contract_get shows it, run with story phase DEV and phase REVIEW (no PLAN return).

entries.desc: The effective-binding projection excludes withdrawn bindings while the original ProofStoryAcceptanceBinding object is preserved byte-for-byte

evidence.note: effectiveAcceptanceBindings excludes the withdrawn binding while the original acceptanceBindings[AB-1] object survives byte-for-byte (JSON compared before/after).

entries.desc: proofstory_contract_set still refuses to run outside PLAN and cannot be used to write a withdrawal (freeze intact)

evidence.note: COMMAND_POLICIES.proofstory_contract_set.allowedPhases deepEquals ['PLAN'] (freeze intact); scope_shrinkage_decision_set reaches DEV/REVIEW/TEST — the correction path, not proofstory_contract_set, does the withdrawal.

entries.desc: Withdrawing CHK-nnn and AB-mmm under one confirmed+userConfirmed decision stamps both layers with the same decisionId

evidence.note: The withdrawn item.decisionRef and the binding disposition.decisionRef both equal the single stamped decisionId.

entries.desc: A decision that does not cite the item/binding is refused, and citing two different decision ids across the two layers for the same shrinkage is refused

evidence.note: A decision naming a non-existent checklist item (/not a checklist item/) or non-existent binding (/not an acceptance binding/) is refused and mutates nothing; single-applier design makes cross-layer id mismatch structurally impossible.

entries.desc: Layer independence: a decision listing ONLY withdrawnChecklistItemRefs withdraws only the checklist item and leaves its binding active; a decision listing ONLY withdrawnAcceptanceBindingRefs withdraws only the binding and leaves the checklist item unchanged (no silent cross-cancellation)

evidence.note: Layer independence: an item-only decision leaves the bound binding active; a binding-only decision leaves every checklist item unchanged. No silent cross-cancellation.

entries.desc: The internal-call path bypassing Zod is still rejected because handler and consuming gate re-validate; a DEV agent without userConfirmed:true cannot produce a withdrawal

evidence.note: The smoke calls scope_shrinkage_decision_set on the handler directly (the internal, Zod-bypassing path) and the ref/authority refusals still fire at the handler level.

entries.desc: Withdrawing a proper subset of bindings leaves a non-empty effective set; the write-time applier succeeds and the DONE intent-equivalence path proceeds

evidence.note: Withdrawing a proper subset (AB-1 of AB-1/AB-2) leaves a non-empty effective set; the applier succeeds.

entries.desc: Withdrawing ALL acceptance bindings WITHOUT an explicit full-withdrawal re-approval is HARD-REFUSED by the sole applier at write time, independent of doneGateMode (proven by asserting refusal under the default observe config)

evidence.note: Withdrawing all bindings without fullWithdrawalReapproval is HARD-REFUSED (/empty_scope_after_withdrawal/) in a config-less temp root (default observe), proving independence from doneGateMode; with the re-approval field it is allowed.

entries.desc: The floor evaluates the effective (non-withdrawn) set, not the original bindings, so leaving withdrawn originals present cannot fake surviving scope; the DONE empty_scope_after_withdrawal diagnostic exists only as defense-in-depth

evidence.note: The empty-scope floor reads effectiveAcceptanceBindings (non-withdrawn); approved full withdrawal empties the effective set to length 0, so leaving withdrawn originals cannot fake surviving scope.

entries.desc: Positive smoke: after scope_shrinkage_decision_set removing CHK-nnn, checklist_get and proofstory_contract_get both report that item and its binding as withdrawn, from DEV and from REVIEW

evidence.note: Positive both-phase direction (DEV+REVIEW): checklist_get and proofstory_contract_get both report withdrawn; smoke prints PASS.

entries.desc: Negative smoke: done still counts as delivered, withdrawn is excluded from delivered/completed counts, and the original binding survives withdrawal unmodified

evidence.note: Negative direction: done stays delivered (count 1), withdrawn excluded from counts, original binding survives byte-for-byte.
